newsitem.title: USA: First Industrial to develop Wisconsin site.
newsitem.headline: First Industrial to develop Wisconsin site.

text.p: First Industrial Realty Trust Inc, a $1.7 billion real estate investment trust, said Monday it will develop a 466,000-square-foot industrial property in Sturtevant, Wis., for Golden Books Family Entertainment Inc.
First Industrial said it will invest more than $20 million in this venture. When finished, this project will include a production facility and general corporate offices.
Golden Books, a children's book publishing company, has an option to expand future operations up to an additional 500,000 square feet.
Upon completion, the project will increase First Industrial's holdings in Wisconsin to 955,582 square feet.
